notes.title: Release Date and AI Pals Engine
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays!

Based on the feedback I shift the focus of AI Pals to something less complicated and to a more traditional AI assistant application (in a new software categorized project). It will be the priority in 2025 with a release soon.
The new project AI Pals Engine is similar to AI Pals, but with less focus on game elements, but still with a focus on the Workshop, customizable Widgets and more!

Please be sure to check out and consider to Wishlist and Follow the new project as the release is coming soon. The AI Pals release date will remain TBD until AI Pals Engine is fully released.
Here's the link:
AI Pals Engine

Thank You!
